name: Edit a season that has not opened
description:
SOMA-GAPS 1.5, admin only. The Edit button on a `scheduled` row in the seasons table, and the ONLY row it may ever appear on: a season that has not opened has no submissions stamped into it, no matches paired against it and no standings, so its window and its rules are still safe to move. An open one is not -- competitors have already entered it under the rules it states -- and a closed one is the permanent record. The predicate `now() < submissions_open_at` in the UPDATE is what enforces that, so the refusal cannot be raced by a second caller arriving in the second the season opens; `why` then reads the state back and names it, and 409 carries which state it actually found.

The engine digest is NOT editable. It is pinned from games.active_engine_digest at creation and a season plays one engine from beginning to end or its standings mean nothing (06 §4.4). The number is not editable either -- it is last+1 by construction.

Every field is coalesce'd against the stored value, so a PATCH that names one field leaves the others alone, which is what PATCH means. `rules` is replaced whole rather than merged: the seasons_rules_known CHECK refuses an unknown key, so a merge could only ever produce a document the constraint would reject anyway, and replacing it makes `remove the participants allowlist` expressible.

`weight_classes` is editable here for the same reason the window is: a season that has not opened has nothing measured against its caps yet. Once it opens they are frozen by the same predicate, and they have to be -- every version in the season was placed on a ladder by them, and changing a cap afterwards would silently reclassify a field that has already played.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object('id', u.id, 'role', u.role) AS body FROM users u JOIN live_sessions s ON s.user_id = u.id AND s.sid = ($2)::uuid WHERE u.id = ($1)::uuid

UPDATE seasons s SET submissions_open_at = coalesce(($3)::timestamptz, s.submissions_open_at), submissions_close_at = coalesce(($4)::timestamptz, s.submissions_close_at), rules = coalesce(($5)::jsonb, s.rules), weight_classes = coalesce(($6)::jsonb, s.weight_classes) FROM games g WHERE g.id = s.game_id AND g.slug = ($1)::text AND s.number = ($2)::int AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND now() < s.submissions_open_at

SELECT json_build_object('number', s.number, 'state', CASE WHEN s.closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' WHEN now() < s.submissions_open_at THEN 'scheduled' WHEN now() < s.submissions_close_at THEN 'open' ELSE 'settling' END) AS body FROM seasons s JOIN games g ON g.id = s.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND s.number = ($2)::int
SELECT season_json(s) AS body FROM seasons s JOIN games g ON g.id = s.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND s.number = ($2)::int
